newsitem.title: MEXICO: Smith Barney starts ICA with outperform.
newsitem.headline: Smith Barney starts ICA with outperform.

text.p: Smith Barney has initiated coverage of Mexican construction company Empresas ICA Sociedad Controladora ICA with an outperform recommendation, the company told Reuters on Friday.
Smith Barney said its price target for ICA was $20 per ADR, an upside potential of 28 percent potential.
Analyst Carmen Slade said in a report the price target was "driven by 45 percent in projected EBIDTA growth," and expected ICA to receive some $2.6 billion in new contracts during 1997 and 1998.
"News of these contract awards and of the announcement of the restructuring of Mexico's toll road concession program should serve as catalysts for the stock in 1997," Slade wrote.
